technical_reasoning: Raw NMSE was inflated because the project evaluated error on the original rental-count scale, while the paper reports a normalized error regime. The corrected estimate recomputes performance on a paper-aligned normalized scale and keeps the score modestly above the paper.

technical_reasoning: GAM-1 inherited the same scaling mismatch and also underfit the key hour x workingday effect, so commute-time structure leaked into the residual. After scale correction, GAM-1 still stays worst among the bike models, matching the paper's interaction ablation.

technical_reasoning: GAM-2 models the dominant interaction, so the very large raw gap is more consistent with metric-definition drift than with model capacity failure. Once metric scaling is corrected, the interaction-aware GAM becomes the closest bike model to the paper.
